sentences.ko: 여기 계신 분들 다 같은 마음일 텐데요, 두 사람 평생 행복하길 바랍니다.
sentences.text: And I know I speak for everyone here when I wish them a lifetime of happiness.

alts.text: We all just want them to be happy forever, right?
I believe everyone here joins me in wishing them a lifetime of happiness.

sentences.note: **I speak for everyone here** 는 축사나 건배사에서 "다들 같은 마음일 텐데" 하고 모두를 대신해 말할 때 씁니다. **a lifetime of happiness** 는 결혼식 축사에 자주 나오는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그럼 네가 윗집에 올라가서 좀 살살 걸어 달라고 말해 보지 그래?
sentences.text: Well, why don't you go up there and ask him to just like step lightly, please?

alts.text: Just go up and tell him to walk quieter.
Perhaps you could go upstairs and ask him to walk more quietly.

sentences.note: **step lightly** 는 발소리가 안 나게 살살 걷는다는 뜻이라 층간소음 얘기할 때 딱 맞습니다. **why don't you** 는 "~해 보지 그래?" 하고 가볍게 권할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 오늘이 내 직장 생활에서 최고로 좋은 날이야.
sentences.text: This is the single greatest day of my professional career.

alts.text: Best day of my career, hands down.
Today is the greatest day I have had in my professional career.

sentences.note: **the single greatest** 는 최상급 앞에 single 을 넣어 "단연 최고"라고 힘주는 말입니다. 승진하거나 큰 계약을 따낸 날 쓰기 좋고, **hands down** 도 "두말할 것 없이"라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그 친구만큼 나한테 친자매 같았던 사람은 없어.
sentences.text: No one has been more like a sister to me.

alts.text: She's basically my sister.
There has never been anyone who was more like a sister to me.

sentences.note: **like a sister to me** 는 피는 안 섞였어도 가족처럼 가까운 사람을 말할 때 씁니다. **No one has been more** 로 시작하면 "그 누구보다도"라는 뜻이 돼서 축사나 소개하는 자리에 잘 어울립니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그리고 머지않아 내 식당을 하나 차리고 싶어.
sentences.text: And someday soon, I hope to open my own restaurant.

alts.text: Hoping to have my own place soon.
I hope to open a restaurant of my own in the near future.

sentences.note: 가게를 "차리다"는 영어로 **open** 이라고 하면 됩니다. **someday soon** 은 "머지않아"라는 뜻으로 꿈이나 계획을 말할 때 자주 쓰고, 편하게는 가게를 **my own place** 라고도 합니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리 이웃이기도 하니까, 언제 같이 한잔 어때요?
sentences.text: Since we're neighbors and all, what do you say we uh get together for a drink?

alts.text: We're neighbors, right? Wanna grab a drink sometime?
As we are neighbors, would you like to get together for a drink sometime?

sentences.note: **what do you say we** 뒤에 하고 싶은 것을 붙이면 '우리 ~하는 거 어때?' 하는 가벼운 제안이 됩니다. **and all** 은 '~이기도 하고' 정도로 말끝에 덧붙이는 말버릇입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 어제 일 정말 미안해. 그거 계속 생각했어.
sentences.text: Listen, I feel really badly about yesterday and I thought about it a lot.

alts.text: Hey, I feel awful about yesterday. Been thinking about it a lot.
I want you to know that I feel very bad about what happened yesterday, and I have thought about it a great deal.

sentences.note: **feel really badly about** 는 '~ 때문에 마음이 안 좋다'는 뜻으로, 사과를 꺼낼 때 씁니다. 첫머리의 **Listen** 은 진지한 얘기를 시작하겠다는 신호입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 회사에서 일이 생겨서 늦었어. 근데 나 내일 그만둘 거야.
sentences.text: I got caught up at work, but I'm quitting tomorrow.

alts.text: Work held me up. Quitting tomorrow, though.
I was delayed at work, but I am going to resign tomorrow.

sentences.note: **got caught up at work** 는 '일에 붙잡혀서 늦었다'는 뜻으로, 약속에 늦게 나타났을 때 변명으로 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내가 연애 문제는 너 혼자 알아서 하라고 했던 거 있잖아?
sentences.text: You know when I said that I want you to deal with this relationship stuff all on your own?

alts.text: Remember how I told you to handle the relationship stuff yourself?
Do you remember when I said I wanted you to handle these relationship matters by yourself?

sentences.note: **You know when I said** 는 '내가 전에 ~라고 했던 거 있잖아' 하고 예전에 한 말을 다시 꺼낼 때 씁니다. 대개 그 말을 번복하려고 꺼냅니다. **all on your own** 은 '전부 혼자서'입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 잠깐만, 나 하나만 얼른 하면 돼.
sentences.text: I just have to do one thing really quickly.

alts.text: Gimme a sec, gotta do one thing.
I need to take care of one thing very quickly.

sentences.note: **one thing really quickly** 는 나가기 직전이나 무언가를 시작하기 전에 '잠깐만' 하고 양해를 구할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
